in_sanskrit.name: रावण
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Ravana is derived from the Sanskrit root 'rav', which means 'to desire, to crave, or to move swiftly'. The suffix 'ana' denotes the possessor of that quality. Thus, Ravana means 'one who possesses intense desire or passion'. This name is also associated with the demon king of Lanka in Hindu mythology.

in_hindi.name: रावन
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name Ravana is the same in Hindi as in Sanskrit.

in_tamil.name: ரவண
in_tamil.long_meaning: The Tamil meaning of Ravana is 'necessity' or 'inevitability'. This is not directly related to the Sanskrit etymology, but it is an interesting cultural association. Ravana is a significant character in Tamil literature and folklore, and he is often depicted as a powerful and cunning figure.

in_telugu.name: రావణ
in_telugu.long_meaning: The Telugu meaning of Ravana is the same as in Sanskrit.

in_marathi.name: Ravat
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Sun, Power, Hero
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ravat हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ravat is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Ravana', which means 'Sun' or 'Power'. In Hindu mythology, Ravana is the king of Lanka and a powerful demon king who was a formidable adversary of Lord Rama. Ravat is a name that evokes strength, courage, and the power of a warrior.
